prompt.text: A sunny street café scene seen from the pavement at table height: a small round white marble bistro table holding a white ceramic cup of cappuccino with heart latte art on a saucer and a golden croissant on a small plate, with two black wrought-iron bistro chairs. Behind the table, the café front has a plain green-and-white striped awning with no lettering, tall glass windows and terracotta pots of red geraniums. A cobblestone street, warm morning sunlight, soft shadows, no people, and no text or signs anywhere. Photorealistic, 35mm lens.

steps.title: Swap the cappuccino for an iced coffee
steps.prompt: Replace the cappuccino cup and saucer on the table with a tall clear glass of iced coffee with ice cubes, a paper straw and droplets of condensation, standing in the same spot. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the marble table, the croissant and its plate, both chairs, the green-and-white striped awning, the windows, the geraniums, the cobblestones, the lighting and the camera angle.

steps.title: Turn the awning red and white
steps.prompt: Change only the colour of the awning stripes from green-and-white to red-and-white. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the glass of iced coffee, the croissant and its plate, the marble table, both chairs, the windows, the geraniums, the cobblestones, the lighting and the camera angle.

steps.title: Add a sleeping dachshund
steps.prompt: Add a small brown dachshund lying curled up asleep on the cobblestones under the table, in the table's shadow. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the glass of iced coffee, the croissant and its plate, the marble table, both chairs, the red-and-white striped awning, the windows, the geraniums, the lighting and the camera angle.
